content: Every Windows Task Scheduler GBAutomation-* job runs through scripts/Invoke-WithReceipt.ps1, which emits a host-job-run.v1 receipt, pushes it to public.host_job_runs in Supabase, and edge-triggers a Telegram nudge on ok->failed transition. Validation gates every new task through resources/skills/validate-cron-deploy/.
